notes: Fixed: list-page logging recorded some wrong prices. A discount badge could be read as the price ("-5%" logged as $5) and as the item's name, Amazon per-unit prices ($0.28/count) and "Save $20" amounts were taken for the price, and Facebook group or city pages were logged as items. Cart, checkout and order-history pages are no longer read at all, since they list what you bought, not what's for sale. Cleanup: removes the affected list sightings (all generic list sightings on Amazon and Canadian Tire, plus any from cart or order pages); those items are re-logged correctly next time you see them. Product-page visits are untouched.
